predecessor: This fixed panel supersedes an unexecuted 2026-10-22 implementation draft. No observations from that draft exist or are pooled.
evidence_stage: Prospective targeted follow-up conditional on existing fixed representations. Not externally preregistered. Original C2/2h failure remains.
scope: Targeted confirmation of existing fixed representations for Faults 3, 9 and 15. No model retraining or direction reselection.

panel.planning: Target large core contrasts, not the6.6pp F15 variance-ratio advantage. Counts fixed before generation; no result-driven extension.

runtime.host: Recorded per trajectory; exact cross-platform floating equality is not presumed

source.physical_code: Original vendor, controllers, initial state, fault logic and registered horizon byte-identical

rng.transform: Retain original twelve-uniform sequential sum minus6 noise and all TESUB5 disturbance transformations/call order. No normal() substitution.
rng.scope: One uniform sequence per physical run shared across original consumers; observer does not draw; keys distinct across all roles. Modern independent keyed pseudorandom streams, not a claim of mathematical true randomness.
rng.retry: Same run and same key only

simulation.pairing: Same physical trajectory and XMV commands; native post-evaluate XMEAS versus actual fast-controller-input cache age3steps; no extra process/RNG calls.

models.F3_C1: All5 frozen R5 states, native; mean_pool_signed versus same_mean_signed_axis_squared; same learned axis.
models.F15_C3: All5 frozen R5 states, native; moment_pool_squared versus original independently selected mean_pool_squared.
models.F9: Fixed historical H_D01_moment_A01_signed affine map sha7a20407a0fafa0028931de8d73c32b2ceae9585175e59dadd836777a97efcf66; identical beta/intercept for native and controller-input.
models.representation: PCA500, residualbasis, centres/whiteners, axes, selectedindices, reference moments/scales fixed. No reselection/refit.
models.F9_relearning: Not included; does not independently confirm119/120 relearning result.

detector.sides: two for all22 arms includingSquared, as original
detector.reset: episode beginning only; not at onset/alarm

calibration.statistic: max over all960 samples and bothsides separately perarm; same199physicalruns shared
calibration.historical_difference: This newly declared common190/199 design differs from originalR5 247/259 and earlyS25 57/59; original representation and score transforms remain fixed.
calibration.nominal: 5% marginal order-statistic target under exchangeability/continuity, not exact5% conditional FAR
calibration.gate: Complete and hash all199calibration trajectories, then lock thresholds and input hashes BEFORE any evaluation trajectory is generated

endpoints.primary: mean penalized detection loss across40h postonset
endpoints.clean: Noalarm records1..160 and at least one crossing records161..960
endpoints.delay_min: 3*(first post crossing index0-160); firstaffectedrecorddelay0 inherited recorded-sample convention
secondary: delay among each own clean subset(descriptive)
endpoints.no_rescue: Original failed2hF9/C2 remains failed; new40h confirmatory followup is separate

inference.bootstrap_unit: Physical run, preserving all fixedstate/arm/view outcomes; average5states withinrun before resampling; never5N
inference.primary_CI: Two-sided98.3333333333333% percentile Bonferroni3; ordinary95% descriptive also reported; approximate coverage only
inference.support: Adjusted interval entirely in predefined favorable direction
inference.secondary: Descriptive95% paired effect intervals; cannot substitute for main endpoint
inference.single_arm_rates: 95%ClopperPearson physicalrun n; no binomial interval on fractional5state average
inference.FAR: Report everyfixedarm/state actual400normalrate; nominalmatch does not imply realizedsameFAR. Interpret losses with observedFAR.
inference.scope: Conditional on frozen representation and realizedcalibration; excludes training/calibration-population variation
inference.interim: No effect analysis until all1199complete; progress only engineeringcounts and shutdownflags

failure_policy.physical_shutdown: Retain original registered horizon continuation and flags; noseedreplacement/exclusion/syntheticpadding
failure_policy.engineering_interruption: Save partialattempt and retry samekey fromstart; completedruns neveroverwritten
failure_policy.checkpoint: Completed records are retained atomically; interrupted attempts use the same run identity and random key.

limits: Does not retroactively repair old bootstrapintervals, prove independentrelearning, restoreoriginal2hprediction or establish universalTEP/DCS behavior.
